{{Top|leg}}
'''XP-445-T78Y''' was a code that [[Elrood Starport Command]] transmitted to approaching [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. The code allowed the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] to assume control of the vessel when it came within fifty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] of its destination as manual landings were prohibited on [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]].
